function/\"libertas_weather_server\"/pro.Target: Local Weather supplies current conditions, recent weather, and forecasts to help sprinkler apps plan when and how much to water. The service creates a shared weather source for apps such as Smart Sprinkler and uses the Hub's location to retrieve weather from Open-Meteo. Local Weather supplies temperature, relative humidity, precipitation, forecast rain probability, estimated water loss from soil and plants, wind speed, and wind gusts. Local Weather automatically refreshes current conditions every 15 minutes and hourly history and forecasts every hour. The service keeps seven days of recent hourly weather and a seven-day forecast, and sends weather changes to connected sprinkler apps. Connected apps can obtain the latest saved weather or recover missed updates after an interruption. Local Weather saves the last valid location, current conditions, recent history, and forecast separately, keeping available weather through restarts and temporary internet or location-service interruptions. The service supplies the time and freshness deadline of each update so sprinkler apps can recognize older weather. Local Weather clears weather for the previous site and retrieves replacement weather when the Hub reports a changed location. Fresh weather requires location access and an internet connection. Weather remains unavailable until the service knows the Hub's location. Only one Local Weather service can run on a Hub, and multiple sprinkler apps can share that service. Developed by Smartonlabs Inc. (libertas).
